items.text: Minnesota (Wed estimated report; Thursday report not yet found): DNP - LB Blake Cashman (concussion), TE T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest), EDGE Kyle Van Noy (calf), WR Jauan Jennings (calf), DL Tyrion Ingram-Dawkins (ankle), QB Kyler Murray (hamstring). Limited - S Jay Ward (knee), QB Carson Wentz (ankle). Full - S Theo Jackson (quad). Newly acquired Kirk Cousins expected to start, with Wentz as backup if healthy.
items.source: CBS Sports (NFL Week 10 injury report, Nov 11)

items.text: Green Bay (Thu practice): DNP - RB Josh Jacobs (broken finger, surgery Fri; may miss only two games), C Sean Rhyan (ankle; John Williams likely starts at C), LB Zaire Franklin (shin, likely misses 4th straight), S Javon Bullard (ankle/knee), EDGE Lukas Van Ness (back), TE Josh Whyle (concussion). EDGE Micah Parsons (knee, PUP window) practicing in pads; unclear if in team drills. RB Chris Brooks and WR Skyy Moore (IR return windows) practicing; LB Ty'Ron Hopper (illness) practiced. Jordan Love starts.
items.source: Packers On SI (Packers Thursday update from practice, Nov 12)
